thread:
maria: heads up — decode p95 jumped ~3.4x on canary after the runtime PR that landed this morning (merge 3a4b5c6). traces point to attention falling back to the generic aten kernel for a lot of long-seq requests. attaching quick profiler snippet. :eyes:

sam: can you paste the bench command you ran?

maria: repro is `./scripts/decode-bench --model llm-13b --seq 1024 --batch 4 --iters 200`
output snippet:
```
baseline p95: 41.2ms
canary p95: 142.6ms
kernel breakdown:
  fused_attn_opt (fast): 18% time
  aten_attn (generic): 59% time  <-- regression
  kv-prefetch: 12% time
  decode-overhead: 11% time
```

shubham: fwiw the PR touched fused op selector ordering and a new fallback path for non-packed heads. I changed a branch to prefer the new generic kernel when heuristics couldn't guarantee alignment — maybe it's too conservative. PR: https://git.internal/r/9876 :grimacing:

lisa: CI decode-bench job 8791 also flagged this: job link https://ci.internal/builds/8791
CI numbers: baseline 39.8ms -> head 138.9ms (+3.5x).

maria: also noticed KV-cache hit-rate dipped ~7% on canary; profiler shows extra memcpy and reallocation when kernel switches mid-request — might be invalidating some cached layout assumptions.

sam: can we bisect to the specific commit in that merge? ask: which commit introduced the fallback change?

shubham: bisect (quick run) points to merge commit 3a4b5c6 -> subcommit 5d6e7f (kernel_selector.py rewire). I can prepare a minimal repro patch to toggle the fallback off.

maria: generated a hotpatch that forces prefer_fused=True and ran bench: p95 down to 44.1ms on canary. patch diff: 
```
- if not aligned: use_generic()
+ if not aligned and fallback_allowed: use_generic()
+ # temporarily force fused for canary
+ fallback_allowed = os.getenv('FORCE_FUSED', '1') != '1'
```

deploy-bot: Canary hold applied on runtime-canary-2026-03-18 by maria (:no_entry_sign:)

lisa: recommend blocking rollout until revert/hotfix lands. This will affect a subset of production traffic for seq>512.

sam: agree. please open an ops incident if prod starts seeing errors but so far only canary spiked.

maria: opened PR #9901 to revert the heuristic rewrite. short description: revert kernel-selector reordering; add unit test for head alignment edgecases.

oncall-bot: Revert PR #9901 merged and deployed to canary at 2470012388 (deploy/runtime-canary v2026.3.18-hotfix).

maria: post-rollback numbers: p95 39.0ms, KV hit-rate back to baseline. running extended canary for 2h. :thumbsup:

shubham: thanks all — I'll follow up with a more conservative heuristic and a perf test that exercises long sequences + odd head dims. adding tests to the repo so this doesn't slip.

lisa: please add a changelog note and link the CI perf regression to the revert PR. ops will lift the canary hold after 2h clear.

maria: noted, will do.

sam: great triage. we should also add a short perf smoke in the pre-merge pipeline that runs `--seq 1024 --batch 4` for the high-risk files (kernel_selector.py, fused ops).

maria: agreed — created ticket RD-4321.

lisa: :shipit: once tests are in and canary stays green.

maria: closing loop here. if anyone sees residual p95 blips ping me directly.
